subject.title: Add external event hooks for quota and provider state changes

question: Should CodexBar support persisted, event-triggered execution of user-configured local commands after the argv editor is made lossless?
rationale: Tests can validate the implementation, but they cannot decide whether background execution from shared configuration is an acceptable permanent CodexBar product and security boundary.

options.title: Approve guarded hooks
options.body: Accept the opt-in direct-exec design after fixing argument round-tripping and retaining the absolute-path, minimal-environment, timeout, redaction, and disabled-by-default safeguards.

options.title: Limit the first version
options.body: Ship only CLI/config management or a narrower event set until the settings UX and execution policy have been further calibrated.

options.title: Decline command execution
options.body: Keep CodexBar observability-only and pursue a non-executing event export or polling interface instead.

recommendation.title: Approve guarded hooks
recommendation.body: Accept the opt-in direct-exec design after fixing argument round-tripping and retaining the absolute-path, minimal-environment, timeout, redaction, and disabled-by-default safeguards.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository owner and release decision-maker, steipete is the strongest available owner for accepting or rejecting a new durable command-execution boundary.
